title: Shaxsiy dars
why: Kecha Unit 9 da 11 ta yangi xato bo'ldi, tartib sonlar esa 3 haftadan beri qiyin. Bugun shularni yopamiz.

feedback.you: Yesterday a funny thing happen in the bus.
feedback.fix: Yesterday a funny thing happened on the bus.
feedback.izoh: O'tgan ish haqida fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi: happen → happened. Avtobus ichida «on the bus» deyiladi.

o: I have a bath in the morning.
I have a shower in the morning.
The children have a bath in the evening.
The children have a shower in the evening.

items.izoh: skirt — yubka, shirt — ko'ylak. Farqi bitta harf: sKirt.

o: My birthday is on the twelve of September.
My birthday is on the twelfth of September.
items.izoh: Sanada tartib son ishlatiladi: the twelfth of September.
Oy nomlari katta harf bilan yoziladi: September.

o: Today is the twentieth of November.
Today is the twenty of November.
items.izoh: Sanada doim tartib son: the twentieth.

items.q: «Uyimga osh yeyishga keling!» — bo'sh joy: ___ to my house for plov!
items.izoh: come — kelmoq. Taklifda gap shu so'z bilan boshlanadi.

o: Can I have the receipt, please?
Can I have the recipe, please?
items.izoh: receipt — chek (o'qilishi: ri-SIIT, «p» o'qilmaydi). recipe — ovqat retsepti.

items.q: «Navro'z — katta voqea.» — Navruz is a big ___.

lines.en: It was a rainy Sunday in Tashkent.
My friend Aziz came to my house at ten.
lines.uz: Do'stim Aziz soat o'nda uyimga keldi.

lines.en: We watched a comedy and had a good time.
lines.uz: Biz komediya ko'rdik va yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdik.

lines.en: I forgot the plov on the cooker!
We ate bread and laughed a lot.
lines.uz: Biz non yedik va ko'p kuldik.

items.q: «happen» so'zi bilan kecha bo'lgan bir voqea haqida bitta gap yozing.
Sevgan faslingiz va ob-havosi haqida bitta gap yozing (sunny, rainy, cold…).
